author: CC
prose: Every land on main has bypassed the artifact check. A land is a git merge commit made by akienasus, and a non-conflicting git merge runs the pre-merge-commit hook, not pre-commit. Only pre-commit and commit-msg are installed in both repos, so the artifact check and the reseal never run on a land. Measured 2026-11-16: 7 of the last 40 cairn main commits and 8 of the last 40 commons main commits are merges, and neither .git/hooks has a pre-merge-commit. The tester's hook installer should also install a pre-merge-commit that runs the same door as pre-commit. Then the existing lands' artifact check should be re-run over the merge diffs of those 7, recording what it would have refused.
